```{r, include = FALSE}
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in datasets
# -------------------------------------------------------------
extra_cvd <- read_sas("~/Dropbox/LAGO EXTRA-CVD/Data/extracvd_clean_internal_21mar24.sas7bdat")
enrollment_data <- read.csv("/Users/minhthubui/Dropbox/LAGO EXTRA-CVD/Data/EXTRACVD_date_shifted_enrollment_2025_01_30.csv")
enrollment_data$enroll_date_shifted <- as.Date(as.character(enrollment_data$enroll_date_shifted),
                                               format = "%m/%d/%Y")

# Merge datasets by patient id
data <- merge(extra_cvd, enrollment_data, by = "pid", all = TRUE)
# A = UH, B = Metro, and C = Duke.
# Subset to needed columns
data <- data[, c("pid","redcap_data_access_group","enroll_date_shifted", "malesexx", "hx_HD",
                 "pc_date","pc_counsel_bp", "pc_counsel_risk",
                 "pc_counsel_meds","pc_counsel_sideeffects","pc_counsel_diet","pc_counsel_phys","pc_counsel_smoke",
                 "homebp_dateentry", "homebp_sysbp", 
                 "sbp_final","blvisit", "m4visit", "m8visit","m12visit", "studyarm", "wd_date")]

# 1: Male, 0: Female
data$enroll_date_shifted <- as.Date(data$enroll_date_shifted)
data$center <- as.factor(data$redcap_data_access_group)
data$studyarm <- as.factor(data$studyarm)

data$center <- ifelse(data$center == "uh", "A",
                      ifelse(data$center == "metro", "B",
                             ifelse(data$center == "duke", "C", data$center)))

# Create a numeric version of enrollment date (day 0 = minimum enroll date)
min_date <- min(data$enroll_date_shifted, na.rm = TRUE)
date_mapping <- data.frame(
  enroll_date_shifted = unique(data$enroll_date_shifted),
  enroll_date_numeric = as.numeric(unique(data$enroll_date_shifted) - min_date)
)
data <- merge(data, date_mapping, by = "enroll_date_shifted", all.x = TRUE)

# For each patient, if all wd_date values are NA then set to 0; otherwise, take the non-NA
data <- data %>%
  group_by(pid) %>%
  mutate(wd_date = if(all(is.na(wd_date))) 0 else na.omit(wd_date)) %>%
  ungroup()

# DEBUG: View(data[, c("pid", "wd_date")]) - All columns are imputed correctly

# Define counseling time mapping (in minutes)
counseling_time_map <- c("0" = 0, "1" = 2.5, "2" = 7.5, "3" = 15, "4" = 20)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(timeDuration_pc_counsel_bp       = counseling_time_map[as.character(pc_counsel_bp)],
         timeDuration_pc_counsel_risk     = counseling_time_map[as.character(pc_counsel_risk)],
         timeDuration_pc_counsel_meds     = counseling_time_map[as.character(pc_counsel_meds)],
         timeDuration_pc_counsel_sideeffects = counseling_time_map[as.character(pc_counsel_sideeffects)],
         timeDuration_pc_counsel_diet     = counseling_time_map[as.character(pc_counsel_diet)],
         timeDuration_pc_counsel_phys     = counseling_time_map[as.character(pc_counsel_phys)],
         timeDuration_pc_counsel_smoke    = counseling_time_map[as.character(pc_counsel_smoke)])

# Create enrollment period and interval (for later merging)
min_enroll_date <- min(data$enroll_date_shifted)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(enroll_period = floor(as.numeric(difftime(enroll_date_shifted, min_enroll_date, units = "days"))/30) + 1,
         enrollment_interval = case_when(
           enroll_period <= 7  ~ 1,
           enroll_period <= 14 ~ 2,
           enroll_period <= 21 ~ 3,
           TRUE              ~ 4
         ))

# Create record-taken dates for each data collection type
data <- data %>%
  mutate(records_taken_date_counseling = enroll_date_numeric + pc_date,
         records_taken_date_homebp     = enroll_date_numeric + homebp_dateentry)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# Precompute Window Start/End Dates for Each Patient
# wd_date == 0 indicates no withdrawal
# ---------------------------------------------------

windows <- data %>%
  group_by(pid) %>%
  summarise(
    enroll_date_shifted = unique(enroll_date_shifted),
    enroll_date_numeric = unique(enroll_date_numeric),
    wd_date = unique(wd_date)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Month 1-4 window 
    window_start_m1_m4 = enroll_date_numeric,
    window_end_m1_m4 = ifelse(wd_date == 0, 
                              enroll_date_numeric + 119,
                              pmin(enroll_date_numeric + 119, enroll_date_numeric + wd_date)
                             ),
    
    # M5-M8 indicator: follow-up extends into M5-M8 if no withdrawal or withdrawal occurs after day 120
    # If a participant withdraws before day 120 (i.e., wd_date < 120), then in_window_m5_m8 will be set to 0
    # This means both window_start_m5_m8 and window_end_m5_m8 will be set to NA
    # These participants don't contribute any data to the Month 5-8 window
    
    in_window_m5_m8 = ifelse((wd_date == 0) | (wd_date >= 120), 1, 0),
    # Only calculate month 5-8 window if indicator is 1; otherwise, set to NA
    window_start_m5_m8 = ifelse(in_window_m5_m8 == 1,
                                enroll_date_numeric + 120,
                                NA),
    window_end_m5_m8 = ifelse(in_window_m5_m8 == 1,
                              ifelse(wd_date == 0,
                                     enroll_date_numeric + 239,
                                     pmin(enroll_date_numeric + 239, enroll_date_numeric + wd_date)),
                              NA),
                              
    # Indicator: follow-up extends into M8-M12 if no withdrawal or withdrawal occurs after day 240
    # Same logic as M5-M8.
    in_window_m9_m12 = ifelse((wd_date == 0) | (wd_date >= 240), 1, 0),
    # Only calculate month 8-12 window if indicator is 1; otherwise, set to NA
    window_start_m9_m12 = ifelse(in_window_m9_m12 == 1,
                                 enroll_date_numeric + 240,
                                 NA),
    window_end_m9_m12 = ifelse(in_window_m9_m12 == 1,
                               ifelse(wd_date == 0,
                                      enroll_date_numeric + 359,
                                      pmin(enroll_date_numeric + 359, enroll_date_numeric + wd_date)),
                               NA)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Merge back into the main dataset
windows_subset <- windows %>% 
  dplyr::select(pid, enroll_date_numeric, wd_date, window_start_m1_m4, window_end_m1_m4, 
         window_start_m5_m8, window_end_m5_m8, in_window_m5_m8,
         window_start_m9_m12, window_end_m9_m12, in_window_m9_m12)

data <- left_join(data, windows_subset)
centers <- unique(data$redcap_data_access_group)

# DEBUG:filtered_data <- windows_subset[windows_subset$wd_date > 0, ]
# 4 people that withdraw after their month-8 but they were not in month-12
# because they did not have m12visit. 
# ids_to_check <- c("CT1040", "CT3088", "CT1117", "CT3027")
# ids_to_check %in% base_dataset_m12_Month12$pid
# The two in the middle are in month-4 and month-8.
```

# Month-4 Data Gathering and Intervention Components:
```{r, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# APPLY FUNCTIONS & MERGE RESULTS
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# --- For Month 1-4 outcomes ---

# Step 1: Create base dataset with pids from m4visit
base_dataset_m4_Month4 <- data %>%
  filter(m4visit == 1 & !is.na(sbp_final)) %>%
  select(center, 
         pid, 
         malesexx,
         enroll_date_numeric, 
         wd_date,
         studyarm) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 2: Calculate values for intervention group
intervention_homebp_m4_Month4 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m4_Month4$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_homebp_m1_m4()

intervention_counseling_m4_Month4 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m4_Month4$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_counseling_metrics_m1_m4()


# Steps 3: Merge intervention results and set control values to 0
final_results_m1_m4 <- base_dataset_m4_Month4 %>%
  left_join(intervention_homebp_m4_Month4) %>%
  left_join(intervention_counseling_m4_Month4) %>%
  mutate(
    # Counseling minutes month 4 outcomes
    total_minutes_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_minutes_m1_m4), 0, total_minutes_m1_m4),
    total_active_days_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_active_days_m1_m4), 0, total_active_days_m1_m4),
    avg_counseling_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(avg_counseling_m1_m4), 0, avg_counseling_m1_m4),
    
    # Home BP measurements month 4 outcomes
    total_homebp_measurements_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_homebp_measurements_m1_m4), 0, total_homebp_measurements_m1_m4),
    total_length_of_stay_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_length_of_stay_m1_m4), 0, total_length_of_stay_m1_m4),
    avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4), 0, avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4),
  )
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# Steps 4: Calculate the delta_sbp_m1_m4. 
  # Get baseline blood pressure data
bl_data <- data %>% 
  filter(blvisit == 1 & !is.na(sbp_final)) %>%
  select(center, studyarm, pid, sbp_bl = sbp_final)

  # Get month 4 blood pressure data
m4_data <- data %>% 
  filter(m4visit == 1 & !is.na(sbp_final)) %>%
  select(center, studyarm, pid, sbp_m4 = sbp_final)

  # Calculate delta sbp (change from baseline to month 4)
bp_data_m1_m4 <- inner_join(bl_data, m4_data) %>%
  mutate(delta_sbp_m1_m4 = sbp_m4 - sbp_bl)

# Step 5: Merge BP change data with the final dataset for use
final_results_m1_m4 <- final_results_m1_m4 %>%
  left_join(bp_data_m1_m4)
```

# Month-8 Data Gathering and Intervention Components:
```{r, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# APPLY FUNCTIONS & MERGE RESULTS
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# --- For Month 1-8 outcomes ---

# Step 1: Create base dataset with pids from m4visit
base_dataset_m8_Month8 <- data %>%
  filter(m8visit == 1 & !is.na(sbp_final)) %>%
  select(center, 
         pid, 
         malesexx,
         enroll_date_numeric,
         wd_date,
         studyarm) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 2: Calculate values for intervention group for both periods, m1-4 and m5-8
intervention_homebp_m4_Month8 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m8_Month8$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_homebp_m1_m4()

intervention_counseling_m4_Month8 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m8_Month8$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_counseling_metrics_m1_m4()

intervention_homebp_m8_Month8 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m8_Month8$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_homebp_m5_m8()

intervention_counseling_m8_Month8 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m8_Month8$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_counseling_metrics_m5_m8()

# Steps 3: Merge intervention results and set control values to 0
final_results_m1_m8 <- base_dataset_m8_Month8 %>%
  left_join(intervention_homebp_m4_Month8) %>%
  left_join(intervention_homebp_m8_Month8) %>%
  left_join(intervention_counseling_m4_Month8) %>%
  left_join(intervention_counseling_m8_Month8) %>%
  mutate(
    # Home BP Month 1-4 period
    total_homebp_measurements_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_homebp_measurements_m1_m4), 0, total_homebp_measurements_m1_m4),
    total_length_of_stay_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_length_of_stay_m1_m4), 0, total_length_of_stay_m1_m4),
    avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4), 0, avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4),
    
    # Counseling minutes Month 1-4 period
    total_minutes_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_minutes_m1_m4), 0, total_minutes_m1_m4),
    total_active_days_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_active_days_m1_m4), 0, total_active_days_m1_m4),
    avg_counseling_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(avg_counseling_m1_m4), 0, avg_counseling_m1_m4),
    
    # Home BP Month 5-8 period
    total_homebp_measurements_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(total_homebp_measurements_m5_m8), 0, total_homebp_measurements_m5_m8),
    total_length_of_stay_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(total_length_of_stay_m5_m8), 0, total_length_of_stay_m5_m8),
    avg_homebp_measurements_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(avg_homebp_measurements_m5_m8), 0, avg_homebp_measurements_m5_m8),
    
    # Counseling minutes Month 5-8 period
    total_minutes_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(total_minutes_m5_m8), 0, total_minutes_m5_m8),
    total_active_days_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(total_active_days_m5_m8), 0, total_active_days_m5_m8),
    avg_counseling_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(avg_counseling_m5_m8), 0, avg_counseling_m5_m8)
    
  )

# Home BP Month 8 outcomes
final_results_m1_m8$avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m8 <- (final_results_m1_m8$avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4 
                                                       + final_results_m1_m8$avg_homebp_measurements_m5_m8) / 2

# Counseling minutes Month 8 period
final_results_m1_m8$avg_counseling_m1_m8 <- (final_results_m1_m8$avg_counseling_m1_m4 
                                                       + final_results_m1_m8$avg_counseling_m5_m8) / 2
```

# --- For Month 1-12 outcomes ---

  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m12_Month12$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_homebp_m1_m4()

intervention_homebp_m8_Month12 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m12_Month12$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_homebp_m5_m8()

intervention_homebp_m12_Month12 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m12_Month12$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_homebp_m9_m12()

intervention_counseling_m4_Month12 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m12_Month12$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
  calculate_counseling_metrics_m1_m4()

intervention_counseling_m8_Month12 <- data %>%
  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m12_Month12$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%
    calculate_counseling_metrics_m5_m8()

  filter(pid %in% base_dataset_m12_Month12$pid & studyarm == 1) %>%

  left_join(intervention_homebp_m12_Month12) %>%

    total_active_days_m1_m4 = ifelse(is.na(total_active_days_m1_m4), 0, total_active_days_m1_m4),

    total_length_of_stay_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(total_length_of_stay_m5_m8), 0, total_length_of_stay_m5_m8),
    avg_homebp_measurements_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(avg_homebp_measurements_m5_m8), 0, avg_homebp_measurements_m5_m8),
    
    # Counseling minutes Month 5-8 period
    total_minutes_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(total_minutes_m5_m8), 0, total_minutes_m5_m8),
    total_active_days_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(total_active_days_m5_m8), 0, total_active_days_m5_m8),
    avg_counseling_m5_m8 = ifelse(is.na(avg_counseling_m5_m8), 0, avg_counseling_m5_m8),
    
     # Home BP m9_m12 values
    total_homebp_measurements_m9_m12 = ifelse(is.na(total_homebp_measurements_m9_m12), 0, total_homebp_measurements_m9_m12),
    total_length_of_stay_m9_m12 = ifelse(is.na(total_length_of_stay_m9_m12), 0, total_length_of_stay_m9_m12),
    avg_homebp_measurements_m9_m12 = ifelse(is.na(avg_homebp_measurements_m9_m12), 0, avg_homebp_measurements_m9_m12),
    
    # Counseling minutes Month 9-12 period
    total_minutes_m9_m12 = ifelse(is.na(total_minutes_m9_m12), 0, total_minutes_m9_m12),
    total_active_days_m9_m12 = ifelse(is.na(total_active_days_m9_m12), 0, total_active_days_m9_m12),
    avg_counseling_m9_m12 = ifelse(is.na(avg_counseling_m9_m12), 0, avg_counseling_m9_m12),
  )

# Home BP m1-m12 period
final_results_m1_m12$avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m12 <- 
  (final_results_m1_m12$avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4 +

                                                   + final_results_m1_m12$avg_counseling_m5_m8
                                                   + final_results_m1_m12$avg_counseling_m9_m12) / 3

# Average comparison table:
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Helper function to calculate mean and 95% CI
summary_ci <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  se <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
  ci_lower <- m - 1.96 * se
  ci_upper <- m + 1.96 * se
  return(c(mean = m, lower = ci_lower, upper = ci_upper))
}

# Step 1: Baseline table (mean only)
baseline_table <- bl_data %>%
  group_by(center, studyarm) %>%
  summarise(SBP_Baseline = mean(sbp_bl, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Delta SBP tables (mean + CI)
delta_m4 <- final_results_m1_m4 %>%
  group_by(center, studyarm) %>%
  summarise(mean_m4 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m4, na.rm = TRUE),
            lower_m4 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m4, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.96 * sd(delta_sbp_m1_m4, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta_sbp_m1_m4))),
            upper_m4 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m4, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.96 * sd(delta_sbp_m1_m4, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta_sbp_m1_m4))),
            .groups = "drop")

delta_m8 <- final_results_m1_m8 %>%
  group_by(center, studyarm) %>%
  summarise(mean_m8 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m8, na.rm = TRUE),
            lower_m8 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m8, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.96 * sd(delta_sbp_m1_m8, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta_sbp_m1_m8))),
            upper_m8 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m8, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.96 * sd(delta_sbp_m1_m8, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta_sbp_m1_m8))),
            .groups = "drop")

delta_m12 <- final_results_m1_m12 %>%
  group_by(center, studyarm) %>%
  summarise(mean_m12 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m12, na.rm = TRUE),
            lower_m12 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m12, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.96 * sd(delta_sbp_m1_m12, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta_sbp_m1_m12))),
            upper_m12 = mean(delta_sbp_m1_m12, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.96 * sd(delta_sbp_m1_m12, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(delta_sbp_m1_m12))),
            .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Merge everything together
final_table <- baseline_table %>%
  left_join(delta_m4, by = c("center", "studyarm")) %>%
  left_join(delta_m8, by = c("center", "studyarm")) %>%
  left_join(delta_m12, by = c("center", "studyarm"))

# Step 4: Recode study arm
final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(Study_Arm = ifelse(studyarm == 0, "Control", "Intervention"))

# Step 5: Format only the ΔSBP columns into "mean (lower, upper)"
final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_SBP_Month4 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", mean_m4, lower_m4, upper_m4),
    Delta_SBP_Month8 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", mean_m8, lower_m8, upper_m8),
    Delta_SBP_Month12 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", mean_m12, lower_m12, upper_m12)
  ) %>%
  select(Facility = center, Study_Arm, SBP_Baseline,
         Delta_SBP_Month4, Delta_SBP_Month8, Delta_SBP_Month12)

# View the final table
print(final_table)


```

### Linear Cost Function:
```{r}
opt_m4 <- lago_optimization(
  data = final_results_m1_m4,
  outcome_name = "delta_sbp_m1_m4",
  outcome_type = "continuous",
  glm_family = "gaussian",
  link = "identity",
  intervention_components = c("avg_counseling_m1_m4", "avg_homebp_measurements_m1_m4"),
  intervention_lower_bounds = c(0, 0),
  intervention_upper_bounds = c(10, 4),
  include_center_effects = TRUE,
  cost_list_of_vectors = list(c(0, 1), c(0, 0.5)),
  outcome_goal = -5,
  outcome_goal_intention = "minimize",
  optimization_method = "grid_search",
  optimization_grid_search_step_size = c(0.1,0.1),
  include_confidence_set = FALSE,
  confidence_set_grid_step_size = c(1, 1)
)
```
